__doc__: Curator fills for INAO parcellaire gaps — see scripts/_lib/parcellaire_gaps.py. Keyed by record slug: `communes` {INSEE (IGN AdminExpress, current): name}, `donors` appellation slugs whose parcels inside the commune stand in for the missing ones (tried in order; whole commune when none has any), `reason` (what the regulator text says), `source` (the files the claim rests on), `verified` (date the layer was checked). A pinned commune that carries a parcel row again is STALE: stage 04 leaves it alone and says so; scripts/audit_parcellaire_gaps.py --strict fails. Re-verify against the new release before removing or keeping the pin.

cotes-du-rhone-villages.reason: All seven are communes of the aire géographique in the cahier (section IV 1°: Ardèche, Drôme, Gard, Vaucluse lists) and in the INAO aires-communes CSV (IDA 1287, 95 communes); six are named communes of a dénomination géographique complémentaire in section IV 2° — Vaison-la-Romaine and Saint-Marcellin-lès-Vaison (« Vaison-la-Romaine »), Saint-Romain-en-Viennois and Mollans-sur-Ouvèze (« Puyméras »), Sérignan-du-Comtat (« Massif d'Uchaux », « Sainte-Cécile »), Visan (« Visan »). The 2026-05-11 INAO parcellaire release carries no row for the commune for any AOC (Vaison-la-Romaine, Saint-Marcellin-lès-Vaison, Saint-Romain-en-Viennois, Mollans-sur-Ouvèze) or Côtes du Rhône rows only (Sérignan-du-Comtat, Sorgues, Visan), so the dissolved Villages polygon had a hole at each — the boundary flag of 2026-09-29 (en, z8.8). Côtes du Rhône parcels stand in where they exist (the Villages delimitation lies inside the Côtes du Rhône one); the other four are drawn whole.
cotes-du-rhone-villages.source: raw/inao/cahier-extracted/cotes-du-rhone-villages.json (aire.aire_geographique; sections IV 1° and 2°); raw/inao/aoc-aop-aires-communes.csv (Aire géographique = Côtes du Rhône Villages, IDA 1287); raw/inao/parcellaire 2026-05-11_delim-parcellaire-aoc-shp: id_app 276 rows by insee

cotes-du-rhone.reason: Communes of the Côtes du Rhône aire géographique (cahier section IV; INAO aires-communes CSV, 172 communes) with no row in the INAO parcellaire release for any AOC — the commune's delimitation is not digitised — so the dissolved polygon had a hole at each.
